punchline: Marie Kondo calls tidying room by room a fatal mistake, because the same kind of thing is scattered through every room.
thirty_sec: Marie Kondo doesn't tidy room by room. She pulls every item of one kind, say every piece of clothing in the house, into a single pile, and only then decides what stays. The order never changes: clothes, books, papers, small miscellany, and keepsakes last. Easy decisions first, photos at the end. Then everything of one type gets stored in one place.
